description: Sewer manholes is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This set of punctual data shows the manholes located on the Island of Montreal. These manholes are compartments through which sewers can be accessed in order to clean, inspect and maintain them. The manholes are placed at regular intervals on the right-hand section of the main pipe. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Room, Water, Waste water, Infrastructure, Pluvial. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB/GDB, HTML, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
